source: make a game called do nothing point idle where its just a black box with lights in the top corners of the room and all they can do is flick the lights on and off and they get 1 (lazy point) per second for doing nothing but when they flick the light it doubles the multiplier on the lazy points but they can know that. also add a donation screen for all the game passes that I have on the left wall

answers.ask: How big is the box — a closet the player barely fits in, or a room they can walk around?
answers.answer: Make it a small room the player can walk around in, with the light switches reachable on the walls.

answers.ask: Is there anything to reach or unlock, or does the game just accumulate points forever?
answers.answer: It just accumulates Lazy Points forever; there are no unlocks or end goal.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: How big is the box — a closet the player barely fits in, or a room they can walk around? A: Make it a small room the player can walk around in, with the light switches reachable on the walls.
- [author] goal — Q: Is there anything to reach or unlock, or does the game just accumulate points forever? A: It just accumulates Lazy Points forever; there are no unlocks or end goal.
- [agent_inferred] lights — Q: How many corner lights and switches should the room contain? A: Use four ceiling-corner lights with four reachable wall switches, one controlling each light.

## Enriched image prompt
Create one small walkable black-box room with plain black walls, floor, and ceiling. Mount one light in each of the four upper corners and place four reachable switches on the walls below, one for each light. Keep the center of the room empty and make the switches the only interactive fixtures. Add one wall-mounted donation display on the left wall, positioned where it does not obstruct a switch or the walking space. Frame the entire sparse room and all four corner lights clearly.

## Genre
The genre is Simulation, canonical slug `simulation`, because this is an idle incremental game whose only physical loop is repeatedly operating room fixtures while points accumulate.

## Shape and preset
Use `interior-single`, Zone (Single Interior), taken from outside Simulation's usual shape list because the entire game occupies one enclosed walkable room with no exterior. No Simulation preset remains recognisable after removing unrequested shops, gates, and progression circulation, so the preset is none.

## Config requirements
Use `trigger-task` for four visible wall-mounted light switches as the repeatable interaction stations. Include four upper-corner light fixtures and one left-wall donation display as scene-specific free-text props; no canonical image option describes those fixtures more accurately.

## Layout requirements
Place exactly four `trigger-task` TriggerZones on reachable wall switches, each directly associated with one of the four ceiling-corner lights. Keep all switches at player height, spaced away from corners enough to approach, and outside the footprint of the left-wall donation display. No ending, unlock gate, rebirth pad, or collectible placement applies.

## Layout components
The build contains one small rectangular black room, one clear central walking area, four upper-corner lights, four reachable wall switches, and one donation display mounted on the left wall. The six room surfaces form the boundary. Compose the view so every light location is understandable and the left-wall display remains legible without dominating the sparse room.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: render the black-box interior, corner lighting, switches, and left-wall display first, then derive the simple rectangular plan. The isometric image is authoritative because fixture placement and the contrast created by the lights are the meaningful visual decisions.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale is small, driven by one walkable room and wall fixtures that must remain readable. The theme is stark minimalist black-box isolation with controllable corner lights. Use `P0`; the entire play space is one single-level interior with no outside transition, overhang, separate map, or validity-by-construction requirement.
